subject: Walled-garden private deploy: technical kickoff — proposed times and reschedule
messages:
From: Tom Briggs <t.briggs@securemed.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Patel <n.patel@securemed.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment — architecture kickoff request

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our infra and security teams reviewed Redwood’s offering and we think a private, air-gapped deployment is the right fit for us given PHI handling. We'd like to schedule a technical kickoff to run through VPC design, HSM/KMS integration and the air-gap requirements checklist.

Top constraints:
- No egress from the secured subnet except approved package repos during maintenance windows.
- HSM-backed key material; customer-managed KMS preferred.
- Offline model import process (we cannot pull containers from public registries during install).

Can Marcus or an engineer from your side join to do a deep-dive? Our initial availability: Aug 5–6 (PDT) afternoons.

Attaching a short infra requirements doc.

Thanks,
Tom Briggs
Director, IT Security
SecureMed

Attachment: securemed-infra-requirements.pdf

Subject: Re: Private deployment — architecture kickoff request

Tom — really appreciate the clear constraints. Marcus (solutions eng) and Lauren (deploy PM) are looped in — both have deep experience with on-prem/air-gapped installs.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Wed Aug 5, 3:00–4:00 PM
- Wed Aug 5, 4:30–5:30 PM
- Thu Aug 6, 2:00–3:00 PM

Agenda suggestion (30–45 min):
1) Customer environment summary & isolation requirements (you)
2) Redwood private topology options: VPC-only vs fully on-prem air-gapped (Marcus)
3) Model import and verification flow (Lauren)
4) Action items and next steps (owners + timing)

I’ll put a provisional invite for Aug 5 3:00 PM while we confirm. Also attaching our private-deploy checklist to speed the review.

Thanks — Priya
